generic-math-checked-operators.title: Preserve checked arithmetic semantics in generic math
generic-math-checked-operators.short: Make overflow behavior explicit in generic numeric algorithms
generic-math-checked-operators.summary: Generic math can use static abstract operators while still distinguishing checked arithmetic from wrapping or type-specific behavior.
generic-math-checked-operators.why: Reusable numeric code should not silently change overflow semantics when moved behind generic constraints.
generic-math-checked-operators.tips: Choose checked or unchecked behavior deliberately and document expectations for custom numeric types.

streaming-json-iasyncenumerable.title: Stream JSON sequences with IAsyncEnumerable
streaming-json-iasyncenumerable.short: Process deserialized items incrementally instead of buffering the whole payload
streaming-json-iasyncenumerable.summary: DeserializeAsyncEnumerable can expose JSON array elements as an asynchronous sequence over a stream.
streaming-json-iasyncenumerable.why: Large payloads can be processed with bounded memory and earlier time-to-first-item.
streaming-json-iasyncenumerable.tips: Keep the source stream alive for the enumeration and propagate cancellation through both reading and downstream processing.

task-run-cpu-bound-concurrency.title: Bound Task.Run fan-out for CPU-bound work
task-run-cpu-bound-concurrency.short: Do not queue one ThreadPool work item per input without a concurrency plan
task-run-cpu-bound-concurrency.summary: Creating a Task.Run for every CPU-bound item can flood the ThreadPool and increase scheduling overhead without increasing available CPU.
task-run-cpu-bound-concurrency.why: Bounded parallelism usually gives more predictable throughput and leaves worker capacity for unrelated work.
task-run-cpu-bound-concurrency.tips: Measure the workload and choose a concurrency limit near the useful CPU parallelism instead of blindly matching input count.

aspnetcore-forwarded-headers-trust.title: Trust forwarded headers only from known proxies
aspnetcore-forwarded-headers-trust.short: Treat X-Forwarded values as network-boundary data
aspnetcore-forwarded-headers-trust.summary: Forwarded headers can restore client scheme and address behind a reverse proxy, but only when the forwarding hop is trusted.
aspnetcore-forwarded-headers-trust.why: Accepting spoofed forwarding headers can corrupt redirect, logging, rate-limit, and security decisions.
aspnetcore-forwarded-headers-trust.tips: Configure known proxies or networks and keep proxy topology explicit instead of trusting arbitrary client-supplied headers.

regex-timeout-untrusted-input.title: Put time bounds on regex matching of untrusted input
regex-timeout-untrusted-input.short: Prevent pathological matches from monopolizing CPU
regex-timeout-untrusted-input.summary: Backtracking regular expressions can take unexpectedly long on adversarial or unlucky input patterns.
regex-timeout-untrusted-input.why: A timeout or a suitable non-backtracking design prevents a single match from consuming unbounded request time.
regex-timeout-untrusted-input.tips: Prefer structurally safe patterns or NonBacktracking when compatible, and handle RegexMatchTimeoutException as an expected failure mode.

valuetask-multiple-await-hazard.title: Do not await an arbitrary ValueTask multiple times
valuetask-multiple-await-hazard.short: Convert to Task when a result must be shared or awaited repeatedly
valuetask-multiple-await-hazard.summary: A ValueTask may wrap a reusable source whose contract permits only one consumption, unlike an ordinary Task.
valuetask-multiple-await-hazard.why: Repeated awaits can fail or produce undefined behavior depending on the underlying source.
valuetask-multiple-await-hazard.tips: Await once by default; call AsTask when multiple consumers or repeated awaits are genuinely required.

csharp-required-members-construction.title: Express mandatory object initialization with required members
csharp-required-members-construction.short: Move missing initialization errors toward compile time
csharp-required-members-construction.summary: The required modifier marks fields or properties that callers must initialize during object construction.
csharp-required-members-construction.why: It documents construction invariants without forcing every data-shaped type into a long constructor.
csharp-required-members-construction.tips: Combine required with sensible nullability and remember that it enforces initialization syntax, not arbitrary runtime validation.

file-async-randomaccess-concurrency.title: Use offset-based file I/O for independent concurrent reads
file-async-randomaccess-concurrency.short: Read separate file regions without sharing a mutable stream position
file-async-randomaccess-concurrency.summary: RandomAccess operations work against a file handle and explicit offsets rather than a shared FileStream position.
file-async-randomaccess-concurrency.why: Independent offsets make concurrent range reads easier to reason about and can avoid position synchronization.
file-async-randomaccess-concurrency.tips: Keep buffer lifetimes valid until asynchronous operations complete and benchmark against simpler sequential I/O for the actual access pattern.

reflection-attribute-instantiation-cost.title: Avoid constructing attributes when metadata alone is enough
reflection-attribute-instantiation-cost.short: Inspect CustomAttributeData on reflection-heavy discovery paths
reflection-attribute-instantiation-cost.summary: GetCustomAttributes creates attribute instances and runs their constructors, while metadata inspection can answer many discovery questions without doing so.
reflection-attribute-instantiation-cost.why: Large startup scans can otherwise allocate and execute unnecessary user code merely to discover annotations.
reflection-attribute-instantiation-cost.tips: Instantiate attributes only when their runtime values or behavior are actually required.

unity-domain-reload-static-state.title: Reset Unity static state when domain reload is disabled
unity-domain-reload-static-state.short: Make play-mode initialization explicit for persistent statics
unity-domain-reload-static-state.summary: With domain reload disabled, static fields can survive between play sessions instead of returning to their normal initial values.
unity-domain-reload-static-state.why: Caches and singleton-like state may otherwise make editor runs depend on what happened in a previous session.
unity-domain-reload-static-state.tips: Use explicit subsystem initialization for state that must reset and test both editor iteration settings and player startup behavior.
